Z21_minimality.claim: 21 irreducible codimension-2 components are necessary and sufficient to support the entire 21-dimensional V_Hdg,Q at once.
Z21_minimality.necessity: For Z with m irreducible surface components, dim H_4^BM(Z,Q)=m, hence dim im(H_Z^4->H^4)<=m.
Z21_minimality.scope: component-count minimality for unions of codimension-2 irreducible supports at the degree-4 top-support carrier level; not minimal degree/complexity of one singular support scheme.
Z21_minimality.sufficiency: The frozen 21-plane support Z_21 has nonzero Gram determinant 27 and image V_Hdg,Q.

phase_A_independence_certificate.source_inputs: Fermat equation, character Hodge carrier, plane support equations, exact intersection/purity/Gysin source mathematics only.

proof.equality: The 21-dimensional support image therefore equals V_Hdg,Q.
proof.lower_bound: Source-generated 405-plane Gysin Gram has rank 21; a canonical RREF principal pivot minor has determinant 27.
proof.upper_bound: Every codimension-2 support Gysin image is of Hodge type (2,2), and the cycle-independent rational Hodge carrier has dimension 21.
